subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI header logo/icon not displaying after 2026.3.24 update

question: Should OpenClaw support legacy or arbitrary non-tab Control UI prefixes such as /connections/chat when no gateway.controlUi.basePath is configured, or should those URLs be treated as unsupported and the linked fork PR closed?
rationale: Current main covers root, configured basePath, and internal namespace public-asset paths, but the remaining behavior depends on the supported Control UI URL contract rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Support legacy prefixes
options.body: Land or replace the linked fork work with a narrow fix that prevents phantom basePath public-asset URLs while preserving configured-basePath behavior.

options.title: Declare unsupported paths
options.body: Confirm that root, known routes, configured basePath, and /__openclaw__/ are the supported entries, then close the linked fork PR as not needed.

recommendation.title: Support legacy prefixes
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked fork work with a narrow fix that prevents phantom basePath public-asset URLs while preserving configured-basePath behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent current-main history on the gateway public-asset and route-prefix helpers involved in the remaining decision.
